description: Header file defining interfaces for interactive rebase functionality, including functions for editing and checking TODO lists related to rebase operations.

methods.name: append_todo_help
methods.description: Appends help information for a rebase command to a buffer.

methods.name: edit_todo_list
methods.description: Allows editing of the TODO list during an interactive rebase process.

methods.name: todo_list_check
methods.description: Checks the integrity or correctness of a TODO list.

methods.name: todo_list_check_against_backup
methods.description: Validates the current TODO list against a backup or previous state.
